desiredFields.description:
Nurse Vault is a private, offline-capable clinical reference vault for nursing practice — available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

• Zero data collection — we operate no servers
• Stores in your private iCloud (CloudKit) — only you can access it
• Offline use — works anywhere, no connection needed
• Drag-and-drop file import — PDFs, images, text, folders
• 2,800+ Merck Manual articles bundled (28 specialties, works offline)
• 2,383 drug profiles with dosing, side effects, and nursing considerations
• Search across titles, notes, and file content
• Custom sections with unlimited documents

Your data stays on your devices and your private iCloud. No accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking.
desiredFields.whatsNew:
• iPhone: User-added images now support pinch-to-zoom (up to 4x) and pan — double-tap to reset
• Watch: Fixed — sections and documents now appear from your synced vault. Browse by section, search all documents, view document notes and metadata
• Watch: Document detail shows notes and file information. Full PDF/image previews require the source file from your iPhone or Mac
• Improved sync reliability and summary file format
